title: Paper 1: corrections to the events check after the v29 review (draft v30)
notes: The external review of draft v29 found three errors in the events check (netsurf-manuelbv-0053), all confirmed in the code: the sampled share is a ratio of the two parts' second moments, not a fraction of the total's; expected flip counts were extrapolated from samples; the distance from normal is read at bin edges, too coarse to name 1e-2 as a threshold. Fixed: exact unprotected-bit counts and exact event variance fraction computed without drawing faults (workflows/event_background_exact.py, run folder paper1_event_background_exact_v1, registry entry 84; built-in check that the unprotected fraction equals 20480/21845 on every layer); figure, appendix text and plan record corrected; Fig. 2 says a single event can dominate the change of a neuron's input. Paper worktree commit 12ba3ee. Verified: PDF (40 pages) and standalone Overleaf zip build with no undefined references; looked at the rebuilt figure. Not done: the review's proposal to reword the headline claim (Section 7.2 heading and introduction claim) is left for the owner to decide. Delivery folder workspace/paper1_review/delivery_v30_events_corrections.
